sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The top-level applicability branches remain logically inverted, as noted in prior feedback, and the sh:or therefore rejects both cases: the first SPARQL constraint selects applicable ships as violations, while the second selects non-applicable ships as violations and also imposes the loading-condition requirements. Restructure the branches so the applicable branch's SPARQL query selects only non-applicable ships as violations and then requires every loadingConditionCase with its identifier, result-evidence relationship, and residualStabilityFactorSI=1 OR alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true together with alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true; make the non-applicable branch select only applicable ships as violations and impose no outcome requirements. Preserve the corrected QUDT unit and existing owner/path, datatype, and readiness structures.
